Questions

Before you pay ₹49

What happens after the 30 days end?

Your account and past scores stay saved — only the tests themselves lock. Pay ₹49 again any time to unlock another 30 days; nothing auto-renews or auto-charges you.

Is this affiliated with the Bar Council of India?

No. Panther Law Prep is an independent mock-test resource built to the AIBE's pattern — it isn't run or endorsed by the Bar Council of India.

Can I retake a test as many times as I want?

Yes — every mock, sectional and topic test can be attempted as many times as you like within your 30-day window. Only your most recent score is shown on the dashboard, but nothing stops you from practising a test again.

Do you offer refunds?

Since ₹49 unlocks the full library instantly, we don't offer refunds once a payment is made — the price is intentionally kept low so you can try it without much risk.

Will more tests be added during my 30 days?

Yes — new mock, sectional and topic tests are added over time, and anything published during your active access is included at no extra cost.
